name: 打印Hierarchy结构
cmd:
local Scene = CS.UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager
local lines = {}
local function traverse(tf, depth)
    local indent = string.rep("  ", depth)
    local go = tf.gameObject
    local tag = ""
    if not go.activeSelf then
        tag = " [inactive]"
    end
    local childCount = tf.childCount
    local comp = ""
    if childCount > 0 then
        comp = " (" .. childCount .. ")"
    end
    table.insert(lines, indent .. tf.name .. comp .. tag)
    for i = 0, childCount - 1 do
        traverse(tf:GetChild(i), depth + 1)
    end
end
local sceneCount = Scene.sceneCount
for s = 0, sceneCount - 1 do
    local scene = Scene.GetSceneAt(s)
    table.insert(lines, "===== Scene: " .. scene.name .. " =====")
    local roots = scene:GetRootGameObjects()
    for i = 0, roots.Length - 1 do
        traverse(roots[i].transform, 0)
    end
end
print(table.concat(lines, "\n"))

name: 打开demoRecommendRoleDetail
cmd:
do
    local DebugBaseCfgId = nil -- 想指定方案就填数字，例如 1；nil 会自动取当前表里最小的方案Id
    local agency = XMVCA and XMVCA.XTeamRecommend

    local function IsValidNumber(value)
        if XTool and XTool.IsNumberValid then
            return XTool.IsNumberValid(value)
        end
        return type(value) == "number" and value > 0
    end

    local function FindCfg(baseCfgId)
        if IsValidNumber(baseCfgId) then
            return agency:GetTeamRecommendBaseCharacter(baseCfgId)
        end

        local allCfgs = agency:GetTeamRecommendBaseCharacter()
        local minId
        local result
        for id, cfg in pairs(allCfgs or {}) do
            local cfgId = tonumber(cfg and cfg.Id or id)
            if cfgId and (not minId or cfgId < minId) then
                minId = cfgId
                result = cfg
            end
        end
        return result
    end

    local function FindTargetName(cfg)
        local characterId = cfg and cfg.CharacterId
        if not IsValidNumber(characterId) then
            return "Debug Preview"
        end

        local ids = agency:GetCharacterTargetBaseCharacterIds(characterId) or {}
        local names = agency:GetCharacterTargetNames(characterId) or {}
        for i, id in ipairs(ids) do
            if id == cfg.Id then
                return names[i] or "Debug Preview"
            end
        end
        return "Debug Preview"
    end

    if not agency then
        XLog.Error("[TeamRecommendDebug] XMVCA.XTeamRecommend is nil")
        return
    end

    local cfg = FindCfg(DebugBaseCfgId)
    if not cfg then
        XLog.Error("[TeamRecommendDebug] Cannot find TeamRecommendBaseCharacter config")
        return
    end

    local data = agency:FromCfgData(cfg)
    if not data then
        XLog.Error("[TeamRecommendDebug] FromCfgData failed, BaseCfgId=" .. tostring(cfg.Id))
        return
    end

    XLuaUiManager.Open("UiTeamRecommendRoleTargetDetail", data, nil, FindTargetName(cfg))

    XLog.Debug("[TeamRecommendDebug] Open UiTeamRecommendRoleDetail, BaseCfgId="
        .. tostring(cfg.Id) .. ", CharacterId=" .. tostring(data.CharacterId))
end
